messages:
maria (eng-platform): FYI opened a PR that regenerates API clients for 6 services (auth, billing, search, telemetry, ml-core, feature-flag). It's pure generated code from our codegen tool. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234 — who can approve this? CODEOWNERS points to per-service owners so it's unclear if one approver can merge the whole bump.

kyle (runtime): If it's strictly generated and tests + CI pass, eng-platform has handled bulk bumps before. We usually require owners for any service with behavior changes, but for byte-for-byte regen we've merged with a cross-team sign-off. tagging @vince for api owners.

vince (api-team): I can approve the files under services/{auth,billing} — those are api-team owned. Not comfortable approving search/infra-search or ml-core.

lina (infra-search): I don't approve infra-search files for generated client changes unless the PR contains a notes section about generator version + an explicit diff showing no semantics changed. Can you paste the generator output here?

maria (eng-platform): sure, here's the minimal diff header from the generator (no behavioral changes):
```diff
--- a/services/search/client/version.go
+++ b/services/search/client/version.go
@@
-const ClientVersion = "1.2.3"
+const ClientVersion = "1.3.0"
```
Also updated README snippets and regenerated swagger-derived models only. No logic touched.

kyle (runtime): Two practical paths: 1) collect explicit sign-offs in this thread from each service owner and then eng-platform merges the single PR; 2) split the PR into per-service PRs so owners can merge independently. Option 1 is faster but needs a small admin step if CODEOWNERS prevents a single merge.

maria (eng-platform): I prefer option 1 to avoid churn. Is there an internal CODEOWNER-bypass process we should follow?

sre-bot: CODEOWNER bypass workflow initiated: ticket #5678 created. Please add approvals for the files you own in this thread (literal "I approve" per owner) and confirm the security checklist is met. Admins will review.

vince (api-team): I approve for api-team files (auth, billing).

lina (infra-search): I approve for infra-search (search) now that generator version and diff are present.

kyle (runtime): I approve for runtime-facing SDK glue parts I own.

maria (eng-platform): Added generator version + short changelog entry in the PR description. Thanks — I'll wait for admin sign-off on ticket 5678 and then merge. :thumbsup:
